package sqlstore

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/olivaresai/olivares/core/model"
	"github.com/olivaresai/olivares/core/store"
)

// Fixture adapter only. Every schema, guard, writer and activation instruction
// executes from the archived, unmodified ae19349 v9 implementation.
func TestF2AV9Fixture(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	cfg := store.Config{Engine: store.Engine(os.Getenv("OLIVARES_F2A_ENGINE")), DSN: os.Getenv("OLIVARES_F2A_DSN"), OwnerDSN: os.Getenv("OLIVARES_F2A_OWNER_DSN"), AdminDSN: os.Getenv("OLIVARES_F2A_ADMIN_DSN")}
	raw, err := Open(ctx, cfg, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("v9 Open: %v", err)
	}
	defer raw.Close()
	mode := os.Getenv("OLIVARES_F2A_V9_MODE")
	if mode == "open" {
		return
	}
	if err := raw.System(ctx, func(sys store.SystemScope) error { _, err := sys.EnsureSystemTenant(ctx); return err }); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tenants := []model.TenantID{provisionTenant(t, raw, "historical-first"), provisionTenant(t, raw, "historical-second")}
	var users []model.User
	var sessions []model.AuthSession
	for i, tenant := range tenants {
		if err := raw.AuthMutate(ctx, func(as store.AuthScope) error {
			u, err := as.Users().Create(ctx, model.User{Email: fmt.Sprintf("historical-%d@example.test", i), Status: model.StatusActive})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			users = append(users, u)
			if _, err := as.Memberships().Create(ctx, model.Membership{UserID: u.ID, TargetTenantID: tenant, Role: "viewer"}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			session, err := as.Sessions().Create(ctx, model.AuthSession{UserID: u.ID, Selector: fmt.Sprintf("historical-session-%d", i), SecretHash: []byte("fixture-not-a-secret"), ExpiresAt: model.NewTimestamp(time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour))})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			sessions = append(sessions, session)
			return nil
		}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if mode == "enforced" {
		if _, _, _, err := ActivateDirectoryWriter(ctx, raw, cfg, 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	state, err := readDirectoryWriterControlState(ctx, raw.(*sqlStore).db, raw.(*sqlStore).dia)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := struct {
		Users      []model.User
		Sessions   []model.AuthSession
		Tenants    []model.TenantID
		Mode       string
		Generation int64
	}{users, sessions, tenants, string(state.Mode), state.ExpectedGeneration}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OLIVARES_F2A_MANIFEST"), encoded, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if mode == "writer" {
		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
		for scanner.Scan() {
			phase := scanner.Text()
			err := raw.AuthMutate(ctx, func(as store.AuthScope) error {
				u, err := as.Users().Get(ctx, users[0].ID)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				u.DisplayName = "old-writer-must-not-commit"
				_, err = as.Users().Update(ctx, u)
				return err
			})
			if phase == "staged" {
				allowed := cfg.Engine == store.EnginePostgres
				if (err == nil) != allowed {
					t.Fatalf("old staged write: allowed=%t err=%v", allowed, err)
				}
				fmt.Printf("OLD_STAGED_WRITE: allowed=%t err=%v\n", allowed, err)
				if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OLIVARES_F2A_MANIFEST")+".staged", []byte("phase-complete"), 0600); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				continue
			}
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("old writer unexpectedly committed")
			}
			fmt.Printf("OLD_WRITE_REJECTED: %v\n", err)
			return
		}
		t.Fatal("missing old-writer instruction")
	}
}
